an6.98:1.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:1.2: Anulomikāya khantiyā asamannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:1.3: Sammattaniyāmaṃ anokkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatī ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. 2.
an6.98:2.1: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbasaṅkhāraṃ aniccato samanupassanto anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato bhavissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.2: Anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati.
an6.98:2.3: Sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamamāno sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaṃ vā sacchikarissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī
